text:
neil: Heads up — I'm seeing bad oscillation on the preemptible-backed inference pool in eu-west. When interruption rate spikes, the autoscaler goes into a surge (adds nodes) and then immediate scale-down leaves us underprovisioned for a few minutes. Need ideas on scale-out triggers, cooldowns, surge controls, mixed pools. Repro: interruption burst ~30% for 3m, p95 queue latency up, autoscaler added 12 nodes then removed 10 within 2m. Any quick wins?

tara: First pass — separate scale-in cooldowns for preemptible groups. Make scale-in cooldown = max(5m, 3x interruption_window). Also consider a small "surge budget" reserved during interruption bursts to avoid immediate shrink.

jit: +1. Also use weighted pools: keep a small protected on-demand pool + large preemptible. Autoscaler should prefer adding preemptibles but never go below min_on_demand = 1 per AZ. Quick config sketch:

```
policy:
  scale_out:
    trigger: p95_queue_ms > 200
    step: min(8, pending/4)
  scale_in:
    cooldown: 300
    stabilization: 180
pools:
  - name: preemptible
    weight: 0.9
  - name: ondemand
    weight: 0.1
```

sylvie: uploaded a grafana snapshot: https://grafana.redwood/eu-west/preemptible-burst — you can see node churn and KV cache misses. Cache-miss spikes are the killer; KV warmup ~= 45s per replica which amplifies latency after scale events.

kyle: Could we gate scale-in on cache_miss_rate and latency regression? e.g. don't scale-in if cache_miss_rate > 0.02 or p99 latency increased >5%. That should buy time for caches to warm.

ops-bot: experiment-deploy: autoscaler-v3 rollout started for eu-west-preempt at 1802001125 — canary=3 nodes, monitoring enabled.

neil: Good ideas. Actionables: 1) bump scale-in cooldown to 6m for preemptibles 2) add min_ondemand_per_az=1 3) add cache-miss gate to scale-in 4) enforce surge_limit = 15% of desired capacity. I'll open a PR for autoscaler config and link here.

tara: Also add an interruption_smoothing_window — if interruptions spike but the window is short (<10m), avoid full scale-down. suggestion: smoothing_window = 8m.

jit: For rollout: canary -> 10% traffic holdback -> 50% -> full. Watch p99 and cache miss. I'll own the rollout plan and the RBAC for the autoscaler switch.

sylvie: :thumbsup: I'll add an alert rule: fire if autoscaler attempts to remove >20% capacity within 2m.

kyle: small nit — make sure our eviction handler drains GPU memory and checkpoints KV snapshot before SIGTERM; otherwise warmup cost after a pod replacement spikes.

neil: Thanks all. I'll create the PR + tickets and ping #eng-oncall when we flip.
